featured_reviews.name: Shubham Desale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently graduated from St Gonsalo Garcia College with a B.Com in Accounting & Finance, and overall, I had a positive experience. The faculty for most subjects in commerce is excellent—knowledgeable, approachable, and always willing to help students. However, there’s room for improvement with the IT faculty for commerce, as some instructors come from a science background and lack the necessary expertise in commerce-related IT topics.

While the college does offer a good foundation for commerce studies, I believe the textbooks provided, especially for subjects like taxation, need to be updated to reflect current laws and practices. Another area where the college could improve is by encouraging more research initiatives for students.

The classrooms are well-maintained and clean, though it would be helpful to have dustbins in each classroom for added convenience. Additionally, while the college campus is quite nice, I feel that expanding the ground area and utilizing some of the free space could enhance the student experience.

One concern I had during my time there is the ID card checking at the entrance. In my opinion, security could be stricter to ensure only students and authorized personnel can access the campus.

Overall, St Gonsalo Garcia College offers a solid educational experience, and with a few improvements, it can become even better.

Thank you to all the faculty and staff at St Gonsalo Garcia College for your guidance and support throughout my journey. I truly appreciate the learning experience and the memories I made here.

customer_updates.text:
Blood Donation Camp at Vasai Railway Station – Review (College Memories 📝)

Event Overview

The Blood Donation Camp was successfully organized at Vasai Railway Station in collaboration with NSS Unit SSSM College Naigaon, Rotary Club of Vasai & Virar, Sunrise Oncology Centre, and Maheshwari Seva Sanstha, Vasai. The camp took place on April 4, 2024, from morning till late afternoon, providing a well-managed and hygienic setup for blood donors.

Organization & Setup

The venue was strategically chosen near Vasai Railway Station, ensuring easy accessibility.

The setup included multiple beds for donors, medical equipment, and cooling arrangements (fans and coolers) for comfort.

Volunteers actively guided donors and ensured smooth operations.

Clear banners and informative posters emphasized the importance of blood donation.

Participation & Impact

As students of SSSM College and volunteers, we had an enriching experience organizing and managing the camp.

We learned valuable skills such as event coordination, teamwork, and public engagement.

Our college principal and professors, especially Vandana Ma’am, played a crucial role in encouraging us to participate and contribute to this noble cause. Their motivation inspired many students to step forward and donate.

A good number of students, faculty, and general public participated in donating blood.

Medical professionals ensured a safe and hygienic donation process.

Donors were provided refreshments and a token of appreciation.

The event promoted awareness about the lifesaving impact of blood donation, reinforcing community service values among students.

Highlights

✔ Hands-on learning experience for student volunteers.
✔ Strong encouragement from our college principal and professors, boosting student participation.
✔ Well-organized medical setup ensuring donor safety.
✔ Strong collaboration between college, medical institutions, and service organizations.
✔ Enthusiastic participation from students and community members.
✔ Positive social impact by contributing to local blood banks.

Areas for Improvement

Increased public outreach to encourage more participation.

More awareness campaigns before the event to boost engagement.

Consider extending donation hours to accommodate more donors.

Final Verdict

The blood donation camp was a well-organized, impactful, and socially responsible initiative. As students and volunteers from SSSM College, we not only contributed to a noble cause but also gained valuable learning experiences in teamwork, event management, and community service. With the support of our principal and professors, especially Vandana Ma’am, we felt motivated and empowered to participate in this meaningful initiative.

An Outstanding Institution Shaping Young Minds

St. Francis Xavier's High School, Naigaon, stands out as a remarkable institution dedicated to holistic student development. The management's forward-thinking approach is evident in their exceptional infrastructure and innovative curricular and extra-curricular initiatives that cater to children from diverse backgrounds.

The school boasts a team of dedicated, experienced staff who employ creative teaching methods, leveraging TLM and advanced audio-visual techniques, using 4K projectors installed in every classroom and smart TVs for pre-schoolers. This ensures an engaging and enriching learning environment for all students. Principal Madam Mrs. Sunita Fernandes looks after the smooth running of both schools - St. Francis Xavier's High School and Little Rose Nature School.

Sports enthusiasts will appreciate the state-of-the-art SFX Turf and SFX Sports Hall, built to international standards, offering facilities for cricket, football, badminton, and volleyball by Managing Director Mr. Priben Pereira. The school's recent victories in inter-school tournaments further demonstrate its commitment to excellence in sports by guidance of their experienced coaches .

What sets St. Francis Xavier's High School apart is its emphasis on inculcating moral values. Assemblies filled with action songs and words of wisdom, led by the inspiring Manager Sir Mr. Benedict Pereira, nurture students’ minds and align their thoughts with positivity and purpose.

If you're seeking an institution where academic excellence meets character building, St. Francis Xavier's High School, Naigaon, is a shining example!

featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Royal Showcase event held at our college was a memorable and vibrant occasion that highlighted the creativity, talent, and teamwork of the students. The event was well-organized and reflected the spirit of hospitality and professionalism expected from students of the hotel management field.
The atmosphere of the event was truly grand and lively. The venue was beautifully decorated with elegant themes that gave a royal and luxurious feel to the entire setup. The arrangement of lights, table settings, and stage decorations created an impressive ambience and attracted the attention of everyone present. It felt like attending a professional hospitality event rather than a regular college function.
One of the most impressive aspects of the Royal Showcase was the presentation of food and beverage service. Students demonstrated their practical skills by showcasing different styles of service, table layouts, and hospitality techniques. The table setups were neat, well-planned, and creatively designed. It clearly reflected the training and effort put in by the students.
The food section was also very impressive. A variety of dishes were displayed and prepared with great attention to presentation and taste. The plating was creative and visually appealing, which is an important aspect of culinary arts. The aroma and display of the food items made the event even more enjoyable for the guests.
Another highlight of the event was the teamwork and coordination among the students. Everyone performed their duties professionally, whether it was service, food preparation, hosting guests, or managing the event. Their discipline and dedication were clearly visible throughout the showcase.
The event was not only entertaining but also educational and inspiring. It gave students practical exposure to real hospitality event management and helped them gain confidence in their skills. It also allowed them to display their knowledge of food production, food and beverage service, and event organization.
Overall, the Royal Showcase was a grand success. It provided a platform for students to showcase their talent, creativity, and professional abilities. The event was enjoyable, well-managed, and left a lasting impression on everyone who attended it. Such events are very valuable for students as they help in developing practical knowledge and preparing them for the hospitality industry.
